verses.original: Καὶ ὅτε ἤγγισαν εἰς Ἱεροσόλυμα καὶ ἦλθον εἰς Βηθφαγὴ εἰς τὸ ὄρος τῶν Ἐλαιῶν τότε Ἰησοῦς ἀπέστειλεν δύο μαθητὰς
verses.transliteration: Kai hote ēngisan eis Hierosolyma kai ēlthon eis Bēthphagē eis to oros tōn Elaiōn tote Iēsous apesteilen dyo mathētas
verses.literal: As they approached . . . Jerusalem and came to Bethphage on the Mount of Olives Jesus sent out two disciples
verses.literalPt: E, QUANDO se aproximaram de Jerusalém, e chegaram a Betfagé, ao Monte das Oliveiras, enviou, então, Jesus dois discípulos, dizendo-lhes:

verses.original: λέγων αὐτοῖς Πορεύεσθε εἰς τὴν κώμην τὴν κατέναντι ὑμῶν καὶ εὐθέως εὑρήσετε ὄνον δεδεμένην καὶ πῶλον μετ’ αὐτῆς λύσαντες ἀγάγετέ μοι
verses.transliteration: legōn autois Poreuesthe eis tēn kōmēn tēn katenanti hymōn kai eutheōs heurēsete onon dedemenēn kai pōlon met’ autēs lysantes agagete moi
verses.literal: saying to them Go into the village ahead of you and at once you will find a donkey tied there with her colt beside her Untie them and bring them to Me
verses.literalPt: Ide à aldeia que está defronte de vós, e logo encontrareis uma jumenta presa, e um jumentinho com ela; desprendei-a, e trazei-mos.

verses.original: καὶ ἐάν τις ὑμῖν εἴπῃ τι ἐρεῖτε ὅτι Ὁ Κύριος αὐτῶν χρείαν ἔχει εὐθὺς δὲ ἀποστελεῖ αὐτούς
verses.transliteration: kai ean tis hymin eipē ti ereite hoti HO Kyrios autōn chreian echei euthys de apostelei autous
verses.literal: If anyone questions . . . you tell him that the Lord needs them and he will send them right away
verses.literalPt: E, se alguém vos disser alguma coisa, direis que o Senhor os há de mister; e logo os enviará.

verses.original: Τοῦτο δὲ γέγονεν ἵνα πληρωθῇ τὸ ῥηθὲν διὰ τοῦ προφήτου λέγοντος
verses.transliteration: Touto de gegonen hina plērōthē to rhēthen dia tou prophētou legontos
verses.literal: This took place to fulfill what was spoken through the prophet
verses.literalPt: Ora, tudo isto aconteceu para que se cumprisse o que foi dito pelo profeta, que diz:

verses.original: Εἴπατε τῇ θυγατρὶ Σιών Ἰδοὺ ὁ Βασιλεύς σου ἔρχεταί σοι πραῢς καὶ ἐπιβεβηκὼς ἐπὶ ὄνον καὶ ἐπὶ πῶλον υἱὸν ὑποζυγίου
verses.transliteration: Eipate tē thygatri Siōn Idou ho Basileus sou erchetai soi praus kai epibebēkōs epi onon kai epi pōlon huion hypozygiou
verses.literal: Say to the Daughter of Zion See your King comes to you gentle and riding on a donkey on a colt the foal of a donkey
verses.literalPt: Dizei à filha de Sião: Eis que o teu Rei aí te vem, Manso, e assentado sobre uma jumenta, E sobre um jumentinho, filho de animal de carga.

verses.original: Πορευθέντες δὲ οἱ μαθηταὶ καὶ ποιήσαντες καθὼς συνέταξεν αὐτοῖς ὁ Ἰησοῦς
verses.transliteration: Poreuthentes de hoi mathētai kai poiēsantes kathōs synetaxen autois ho Iēsous
verses.literal: So the disciples went and did as Jesus had directed them
verses.literalPt: E, indo os discípulos, e fazendo como Jesus lhes ordenara,

verses.original: ἤγαγον τὴν ὄνον καὶ τὸν πῶλον καὶ ἐπέθηκαν ἐπ’ αὐτῶν τὰ ἱμάτια καὶ ἐπεκάθισεν ἐπάνω αὐτῶν
verses.transliteration: ēgagon tēn onon kai ton pōlon kai epethēkan ep’ autōn ta himatia kai epekathisen epanō autōn
verses.literal: They brought the donkey and the colt and laid their cloaks on them and Jesus sat on them
verses.literalPt: Trouxeram a jumenta e o jumentinho, e sobre eles puseram as suas vestes, e fizeram-no assentar em cima.

verses.original: Ὁ δὲ πλεῖστος ὄχλος ἔστρωσαν ἑαυτῶν τὰ ἱμάτια ἐν τῇ ὁδῷ ἄλλοι δὲ ἔκοπτον κλάδους ἀπὸ τῶν δένδρων καὶ ἐστρώννυον ἐν τῇ ὁδῷ
verses.transliteration: Ho de pleistos ochlos estrōsan heautōn ta himatia en tē hodō alloi de ekopton kladous apo tōn dendrōn kai estrōnnyon en tē hodō
verses.literal: A massive crowd spread their cloaks on the road while others cut branches from the trees and spread them on the road
verses.literalPt: E muitíssima gente estendia as suas vestes pelo caminho, e outros cortavam ramos de árvores, e os espalhavam pelo caminho.

verses.original: Οἱ δὲ ὄχλοι οἱ προάγοντες αὐτὸν καὶ οἱ ἀκολουθοῦντες ἔκραζον λέγοντες Ὡσαννὰ τῷ υἱῷ Δαυίδ Εὐλογημένος ὁ ἐρχόμενος ἐν ὀνόματι Κυρίου Ὡσαννὰ ἐν τοῖς ὑψίστοις
verses.transliteration: Hoi de ochloi hoi proagontes auton kai hoi akolouthountes ekrazon legontes Hōsanna tō huiō Dauid Eulogēmenos ho erchomenos en onomati Kyriou Hōsanna en tois hypsistois
verses.literal: The crowds that went ahead of Him and those that followed were shouting Hosanna to the Son of David Blessed is He who comes in the name of the Lord Hosanna in the highest
verses.literalPt: E a multidão que ia adiante, e a que seguia, clamava, dizendo: Hosana ao Filho de Davi; bendito o que vem em nome do Senhor. Hosana nas alturas!

verses.original: Καὶ εἰσελθόντος αὐτοῦ εἰς Ἱεροσόλυμα ἐσείσθη πᾶσα ἡ πόλις λέγουσα Τίς ἐστιν οὗτος
verses.transliteration: Kai eiselthontos autou eis Hierosolyma eseisthē pasa hē polis legousa Tis estin houtos
verses.literal: When Jesus had entered . . . Jerusalem the whole city was stirred and asked Who is this
verses.literalPt: E, entrando ele em Jerusalém, toda a cidade se alvoroçou, dizendo: Quem é este?

verses.original: Οἱ δὲ ὄχλοι ἔλεγον Οὗτός ἐστιν ὁ προφήτης Ἰησοῦς ὁ ἀπὸ Ναζαρὲθ τῆς Γαλιλαίας
verses.transliteration: Hoi de ochloi elegon Houtos estin ho prophētēs Iēsous ho apo Nazareth tēs Galilaias
verses.literal: The crowds replied This is Jesus the prophet from Nazareth in Galilee
verses.literalPt: E a multidão dizia: Este é Jesus, o profeta de Nazaré da Galiléia.

verses.original: Καὶ εἰσῆλθεν Ἰησοῦς εἰς τὸ ἱερόν καὶ ἐξέβαλεν πάντας τοὺς πωλοῦντας καὶ ἀγοράζοντας ἐν τῷ ἱερῷ καὶ τὰς τραπέζας τῶν κολλυβιστῶν κατέστρεψεν καὶ τὰς καθέδρας τῶν πωλούντων τὰς περιστεράς
verses.transliteration: Kai eisēlthen Iēsous eis to hieron kai exebalen pantas tous pōlountas kai agorazontas en tō hierō kai tas trapezas tōn kollybistōn katestrepsen kai tas kathedras tōn pōlountōn tas peristeras
verses.literal: Then Jesus entered . . . the temple courts and drove out all who were buying and selling there . . . . . . He overturned the tables of the money changers and the seats of those selling doves
verses.literalPt: E entrou Jesus no templo de Deus, e expulsou todos os que vendiam e compravam no templo, e derribou as mesas dos cambistas e as cadeiras dos que vendiam pombas;

verses.original: καὶ λέγει αὐτοῖς Γέγραπται Ὁ οἶκός μου οἶκος προσευχῆς κληθήσεται ὑμεῖς δὲ αὐτὸν ποιεῖτε Σπήλαιον λῃστῶν
verses.transliteration: kai legei autois Gegraptai Ho oikos mou oikos proseuchēs klēthēsetai hymeis de auton poieite Spēlaion lēstōn
verses.literal: And He declared to them It is written My house will be called a house of prayer But you are making it a den of robbers
verses.literalPt: E disse-lhes: Está escrito: A minha casa será chamada casa de oração; mas vós a tendes convertido em covil de ladrões.

verses.original: Καὶ προσῆλθον αὐτῷ τυφλοὶ καὶ χωλοὶ ἐν τῷ ἱερῷ καὶ ἐθεράπευσεν αὐτούς
verses.transliteration: Kai prosēlthon autō typhloi kai chōloi en tō hierō kai etherapeusen autous
verses.literal: The blind and the lame came to Him at the temple and He healed them
verses.literalPt: E foram ter com ele no templo cegos e coxos, e curou-os.

verses.original: ἰδόντες δὲ οἱ ἀρχιερεῖς καὶ οἱ γραμματεῖς τὰ θαυμάσια ἃ ἐποίησεν καὶ τοὺς παῖδας τοὺς κράζοντας ἐν τῷ ἱερῷ καὶ λέγοντας Ὡσαννὰ τῷ υἱῷ Δαυίδ ἠγανάκτησαν
verses.transliteration: idontes de hoi archiereis kai hoi grammateis ta thaumasia ha epoiēsen kai tous paidas tous krazontas en tō hierō kai legontas Hōsanna tō huiō Dauid ēganaktēsan
verses.literal: But the chief priests and scribes were indignant when they saw the wonders He performed and the children shouting in the temple courts Hosanna to the Son of David
verses.literalPt: Vendo, então, os principais dos sacerdotes e os escribas as maravilhas que fazia, e os meninos clamando no templo: Hosana ao Filho de Davi, indignaram-se,

verses.original: καὶ εἶπαν αὐτῷ Ἀκούεις τί οὗτοι λέγουσιν Ὁ δὲ Ἰησοῦς λέγει αὐτοῖς Ναί οὐδέποτε ἀνέγνωτε ὅτι Ἐκ στόματος νηπίων καὶ θηλαζόντων Κατηρτίσω αἶνον
verses.transliteration: kai eipan autō Akoueis ti houtoi legousin Ho de Iēsous legei autois Nai oudepote anegnōte hoti Ek stomatos nēpiōn kai thēlazontōn Katērtisō ainon
verses.literal: Do You hear what these children are saying they asked Yes - Jesus answered Have you never read From the mouths of children and infants You have ordained praise
verses.literalPt: E disseram-lhe: Ouves o que estes dizem? E Jesus lhes disse: Sim; nunca lestes: Pela boca dos meninos e das criancinhas de peito tiraste o perfeito louvor?

verses.original: Καὶ καταλιπὼν αὐτοὺς ἐξῆλθεν ἔξω τῆς πόλεως εἰς Βηθανίαν καὶ ηὐλίσθη ἐκεῖ
verses.transliteration: Kai katalipōn autous exēlthen exō tēs poleōs eis Bēthanian kai ēulisthē ekei
verses.literal: Then He left them and went out of the city to Bethany where He spent the night . . .
verses.literalPt: E, deixando-os, saiu da cidade para Betânia, e ali passou a noite.

verses.original: Πρωῒ δὲ ἐπανάγων εἰς τὴν πόλιν ἐπείνασεν
verses.transliteration: Prōi de epanagōn eis tēn polin epeinasen
verses.literal: In the morning as Jesus was returning to the city He was hungry
verses.literalPt: E, de manhã, voltando para a cidade, teve fome;

verses.original: καὶ ἰδὼν συκῆν μίαν ἐπὶ τῆς ὁδοῦ ἦλθεν ἐπ’ αὐτήν καὶ οὐδὲν εὗρεν ἐν αὐτῇ εἰ μὴ φύλλα μόνον καὶ λέγει αὐτῇ Οὐ μηκέτι ἐκ σοῦ καρπὸς γένηται εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα καὶ ἐξηράνθη παραχρῆμα ἡ συκῆ
verses.transliteration: kai idōn sykēn mian epi tēs hodou ēlthen ep’ autēn kai ouden heuren en autē ei mē phylla monon kai legei autē Ou mēketi ek sou karpos genētai eis ton aiōna kai exēranthē parachrēma hē sykē
verses.literal: Seeing a fig tree by the road He went up to it but found nothing on it except . . . . . . leaves May you never bear . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . fruit again He said And immediately the tree withered
verses.literalPt: E, avistando uma figueira perto do caminho, dirigiu-se a ela, e não achou nela senão folhas. E disse-lhe: Nunca mais nasça fruto de ti! E a figueira secou imediatamente.

verses.original: Καὶ ἰδόντες οἱ μαθηταὶ ἐθαύμασαν λέγοντες Πῶς παραχρῆμα ἐξηράνθη ἡ συκῆ
verses.transliteration: Kai idontes hoi mathētai ethaumasan legontes Pōs parachrēma exēranthē hē sykē
verses.literal: When the disciples saw this they marveled and asked How did the fig tree wither so quickly
verses.literalPt: E os discípulos, vendo isto, maravilharam-se, dizendo: Como secou imediatamente a figueira?

verses.original: Ἀποκριθεὶς δὲ ὁ Ἰησοῦς εἶπεν αὐτοῖς Ἀμὴν λέγω ὑμῖν ἐὰν ἔχητε πίστιν καὶ μὴ διακριθῆτε οὐ μόνον τὸ τῆς συκῆς ποιήσετε ἀλλὰ κἂν τῷ ὄρει τούτῳ εἴπητε Ἄρθητι καὶ βλήθητι εἰς τὴν θάλασσαν γενήσεται
verses.transliteration: Apokritheis de ho Iēsous eipen autois Amēn legō hymin ean echēte pistin kai mē diakrithēte ou monon to tēs sykēs poiēsete alla kan tō orei toutō eipēte Arthēti kai blēthēti eis tēn thalassan genēsetai
verses.literal: Truly I tell you - Jesus replied . . . . . . if you have faith and do not doubt not only will you do what was done to the fig tree but even if you say to this mountain Be lifted up and thrown into the sea it will happen
verses.literalPt: Jesus, porém, respondendo, disse-lhes: Em verdade vos digo que, se tiverdes fé e não duvidardes, não só fareis o que foi feito à figueira, mas até se a este monte disserdes: Ergue-te, e precipita-te no mar, assim será feito;

verses.original: καὶ πάντα ὅσα ἂν αἰτήσητε ἐν τῇ προσευχῇ πιστεύοντες λήμψεσθε
verses.transliteration: kai panta hosa an aitēsēte en tē proseuchē pisteuontes lēmpsesthe
verses.literal: If you believe you will receive whatever . . . . . . you ask for in prayer
verses.literalPt: E, tudo o que pedirdes na oração, crendo, o recebereis.

verses.original: Καὶ ἐλθόντος αὐτοῦ εἰς τὸ ἱερὸν προσῆλθον αὐτῷ διδάσκοντι οἱ ἀρχιερεῖς καὶ οἱ πρεσβύτεροι τοῦ λαοῦ λέγοντες Ἐν ποίᾳ ἐξουσίᾳ ταῦτα ποιεῖς καὶ τίς σοι ἔδωκεν τὴν ἐξουσίαν ταύτην
verses.transliteration: Kai elthontos autou eis to hieron prosēlthon autō didaskonti hoi archiereis kai hoi presbyteroi tou laou legontes En poia exousia tauta poieis kai tis soi edōken tēn exousian tautēn
verses.literal: When Jesus returned to the temple courts and began to teach the chief priests and elders of the people came up to Him By what authority are You doing these things they asked And who gave You this authority
verses.literalPt: E, chegando ao templo, acercaram-se dele, estando já ensinando, os príncipes dos sacerdotes e os anciãos do povo, dizendo: Com que autoridade fazes isto? e quem te deu tal autoridade?

verses.original: Ἀποκριθεὶς δὲ ὁ Ἰησοῦς εἶπεν αὐτοῖς Ἐρωτήσω ὑμᾶς κἀγὼ λόγον ἕνα ὃν ἐὰν εἴπητέ μοι κἀγὼ ὑμῖν ἐρῶ ἐν ποίᾳ ἐξουσίᾳ ταῦτα ποιῶ
verses.transliteration: Apokritheis de ho Iēsous eipen autois Erōtēsō hymas kagō logon hena hon ean eipēte moi kagō hymin erō en poia exousia tauta poiō
verses.literal: I will also ask you one question - Jesus replied - and if you answer Me I will tell you by what authority I am doing these things
verses.literalPt: E Jesus, respondendo, disse-lhes: Eu também vos perguntarei uma coisa; se ma disserdes, também eu vos direi com que autoridade faço isto.

verses.original: τὸ βάπτισμα τὸ Ἰωάννου πόθεν ἦν ἐξ οὐρανοῦ ἢ ἐξ ἀνθρώπων Οἱ δὲ διελογίζοντο ἐν ἑαυτοῖς λέγοντες Ἐὰν εἴπωμεν Ἐξ οὐρανοῦ ἐρεῖ ἡμῖν Διὰ τί οὖν οὐκ ἐπιστεύσατε αὐτῷ
verses.transliteration: to baptisma to Iōannou pothen ēn ex ouranou ē ex anthrōpōn Hoi de dielogizonto en heautois legontes Ean eipōmen Ex ouranou erei hēmin Dia ti oun ouk episteusate autō
verses.literal: What was the source . . . of John’s baptism Was it from heaven or from men - They deliberated among themselves and said If we say From heaven He will ask Why . . . then did you not believe him
verses.literalPt: O batismo de João, de onde era? Do céu, ou dos homens? E pensavam entre si, dizendo: Se dissermos: Do céu, ele nos dirá: Então por que não o crestes?

verses.original: ἐὰν δὲ εἴπωμεν Ἐξ ἀνθρώπων φοβούμεθα τὸν ὄχλον πάντες γὰρ ὡς προφήτην ἔχουσιν τὸν Ἰωάννην
verses.transliteration: ean de eipōmen Ex anthrōpōn phoboumetha ton ochlon pantes gar hōs prophētēn echousin ton Iōannēn
verses.literal: But if we say From men we are afraid of the people for they all regard John as a prophet
verses.literalPt: E, se dissermos: Dos homens, tememos o povo, porque todos consideram João como profeta.

verses.original: καὶ ἀποκριθέντες τῷ Ἰησοῦ εἶπαν Οὐκ οἴδαμεν Ἔφη αὐτοῖς καὶ αὐτός Οὐδὲ ἐγὼ λέγω ὑμῖν ἐν ποίᾳ ἐξουσίᾳ ταῦτα ποιῶ
verses.transliteration: kai apokrithentes tō Iēsou eipan Ouk oidamen Ephē autois kai autos Oude egō legō hymin en poia exousia tauta poiō
verses.literal: So they answered - We do not know And Jesus replied Neither will I tell you by what authority I am doing these things
verses.literalPt: E, respondendo a Jesus, disseram: Não sabemos. Ele disse-lhes: Nem eu vos digo com que autoridade faço isto.

verses.original: Τί δὲ ὑμῖν δοκεῖ ἄνθρωπος εἶχεν τέκνα δύο καὶ προσελθὼν τῷ πρώτῳ εἶπεν Τέκνον ὕπαγε σήμερον ἐργάζου ἐν τῷ ἀμπελῶνι
verses.transliteration: Ti de hymin dokei anthrōpos eichen tekna dyo kai proselthōn tō prōtō eipen Teknon hypage sēmeron ergazou en tō ampelōni
verses.literal: But what do you think There was a man who had two sons He went to the first one and said Son go and work today in the vineyard
verses.literalPt: Mas, que vos parece? Um homem tinha dois filhos, e, dirigindo-se ao primeiro, disse: Filho, vai trabalhar hoje na minha vinha.

verses.original: Ὁ δὲ ἀποκριθεὶς εἶπεν Οὐ θέλω ὕστερον δὲ μεταμεληθεὶς ἀπῆλθεν
verses.transliteration: Ho de apokritheis eipen Ou thelō hysteron de metamelētheis apēlthen
verses.literal: I will not - he replied But later he changed his mind and went
verses.literalPt: Ele, porém, respondendo, disse: Não quero. Mas depois, arrependendo-se, foi.

verses.original: Προσελθὼν δὲ τῷ δευτέρῳ εἶπεν ὡσαύτως Ὁ δὲ ἀποκριθεὶς εἶπεν Ἐγώ κύριε καὶ οὐκ ἀπῆλθεν
verses.transliteration: Proselthōn de tō deuterō eipen hōsautōs Ho de apokritheis eipen Egō kyrie kai ouk apēlthen
verses.literal: Then the man went to the second son and told him the same thing I will sir - he said But he did not go
verses.literalPt: E, dirigindo-se ao segundo, falou-lhe de igual modo; e, respondendo ele, disse: Eu vou, senhor; e não foi.

verses.original: Τίς ἐκ τῶν δύο ἐποίησεν τὸ θέλημα τοῦ πατρός Λέγουσιν Ὁ πρῶτος Λέγει αὐτοῖς ὁ Ἰησοῦς Ἀμὴν λέγω ὑμῖν ὅτι οἱ τελῶναι καὶ αἱ πόρναι προάγουσιν ὑμᾶς εἰς τὴν βασιλείαν τοῦ Θεοῦ
verses.transliteration: Tis ek tōn dyo epoiēsen to thelēma tou patros Legousin Ho prōtos Legei autois ho Iēsous Amēn legō hymin hoti hoi telōnai kai hai pornai proagousin hymas eis tēn basileian tou Theou
verses.literal: Which of the two did the will of his father The first they answered Jesus said to them Truly I tell you the tax collectors and prostitutes are entering . . . the kingdom of God before you
verses.literalPt: Qual dos dois fez a vontade do pai? Disseram-lhe eles: O primeiro. Disse-lhes Jesus: Em verdade vos digo que os publicanos e as meretrizes entram adiante de vós no reino de Deus.

verses.original: ἦλθεν γὰρ Ἰωάννης πρὸς ὑμᾶς ἐν ὁδῷ δικαιοσύνης καὶ οὐκ ἐπιστεύσατε αὐτῷ οἱ δὲ τελῶναι καὶ αἱ πόρναι ἐπίστευσαν αὐτῷ ὑμεῖς δὲ ἰδόντες οὐδὲ μετεμελήθητε ὕστερον τοῦ πιστεῦσαι αὐτῷ
verses.transliteration: ēlthen gar Iōannēs pros hymas en hodō dikaiosynēs kai ouk episteusate autō hoi de telōnai kai hai pornai episteusan autō hymeis de idontes oude metemelēthēte hysteron tou pisteusai autō
verses.literal: For John came to you in the way of righteousness and you did not believe him but the tax collectors and prostitutes did . . . And even after you saw this you did not repent and believe him
verses.literalPt: Porque João veio a vós no caminho da justiça, e não o crestes, mas os publicanos e as meretrizes o creram; vós, porém, vendo isto, nem depois vos arrependestes para o crer.

verses.original: Ἄλλην παραβολὴν ἀκούσατε Ἄνθρωπος ἦν οἰκοδεσπότης ὅστις ἐφύτευσεν ἀμπελῶνα καὶ φραγμὸν αὐτῷ περιέθηκεν καὶ ὤρυξεν ἐν αὐτῷ ληνὸν καὶ ᾠκοδόμησεν πύργον καὶ ἐξέδετο αὐτὸν γεωργοῖς καὶ ἀπεδήμησεν
verses.transliteration: Allēn parabolēn akousate Anthrōpos ēn oikodespotēs hostis ephyteusen ampelōna kai phragmon autō periethēken kai ōryxen en autō lēnon kai ōkodomēsen pyrgon kai exedeto auton geōrgois kai apedēmēsen
verses.literal: Listen to another parable There was a landowner . . . who planted a vineyard He put a wall around it dug a winepress in it and built a tower Then he rented it out . . . to some tenants and went away on a journey
verses.literalPt: Ouvi, ainda, outra parábola: Houve um homem, pai de família, que plantou uma vinha, e circundou-a de um valado, e construiu nela um lagar, e edificou uma torre, e arrendou-a a uns lavradores, e ausentou-se para longe.

verses.original: Ὅτε δὲ ἤγγισεν ὁ καιρὸς τῶν καρπῶν ἀπέστειλεν τοὺς δούλους αὐτοῦ πρὸς τοὺς γεωργοὺς λαβεῖν τοὺς καρποὺς αὐτοῦ
verses.transliteration: Hote de ēngisen ho kairos tōn karpōn apesteilen tous doulous autou pros tous geōrgous labein tous karpous autou
verses.literal: When the harvest time . . . . . . drew near he sent his servants to the tenants to collect his share of the fruit
verses.literalPt: E, chegando o tempo dos frutos, enviou os seus servos aos lavradores, para receber os seus frutos.

verses.original: καὶ λαβόντες οἱ γεωργοὶ τοὺς δούλους αὐτοῦ ὃν μὲν ἔδειραν ὃν δὲ ἀπέκτειναν ὃν δὲ ἐλιθοβόλησαν
verses.transliteration: kai labontes hoi geōrgoi tous doulous autou hon men edeiran hon de apekteinan hon de elithobolēsan
verses.literal: But the tenants seized his servants They beat one killed another and stoned a third
verses.literalPt: E os lavradores, apoderando-se dos servos, feriram um, mataram outro, e apedrejaram outro.

verses.original: Πάλιν ἀπέστειλεν ἄλλους δούλους πλείονας τῶν πρώτων καὶ ἐποίησαν αὐτοῖς ὡσαύτως
verses.transliteration: Palin apesteilen allous doulous pleionas tōn prōtōn kai epoiēsan autois hōsautōs
verses.literal: Again he sent other servants more than the first group But the tenants did the same to them
verses.literalPt: Depois enviou outros servos, em maior número do que os primeiros; e eles fizeram-lhes o mesmo.

verses.original: Ὕστερον δὲ ἀπέστειλεν πρὸς αὐτοὺς τὸν υἱὸν αὐτοῦ λέγων Ἐντραπήσονται τὸν υἱόν μου
verses.transliteration: Hysteron de apesteilen pros autous ton huion autou legōn Entrapēsontai ton huion mou
verses.literal: Finally he sent his son to them They will respect my son he said
verses.literalPt: E, por último, enviou-lhes seu filho, dizendo: Terão respeito a meu filho.

verses.original: Οἱ δὲ γεωργοὶ ἰδόντες τὸν υἱὸν εἶπον ἐν ἑαυτοῖς Οὗτός ἐστιν ὁ κληρονόμος δεῦτε ἀποκτείνωμεν αὐτὸν καὶ σχῶμεν τὴν κληρονομίαν αὐτοῦ
verses.transliteration: Hoi de geōrgoi idontes ton huion eipon en heautois Houtos estin ho klēronomos deute apokteinōmen auton kai schōmen tēn klēronomian autou
verses.literal: But when the tenants saw the son they said to one another This is the heir Come let us kill him and take his inheritance
verses.literalPt: Mas os lavradores, vendo o filho, disseram entre si: Este é o herdeiro; vinde, matemo-lo, e apoderemo-nos da sua herança.

verses.original: καὶ λαβόντες αὐτὸν ἐξέβαλον ἔξω τοῦ ἀμπελῶνος καὶ ἀπέκτειναν
verses.transliteration: kai labontes auton exebalon exō tou ampelōnos kai apekteinan
verses.literal: So they seized him and threw him out of the vineyard and killed him
verses.literalPt: E, lançando mão dele, o arrastaram para fora da vinha, e o mataram.

verses.original: Ὅταν οὖν ἔλθῃ ὁ κύριος τοῦ ἀμπελῶνος τί ποιήσει τοῖς γεωργοῖς ἐκείνοις
verses.transliteration: Hotan oun elthē ho kyrios tou ampelōnos ti poiēsei tois geōrgois ekeinois
verses.literal: Therefore when the owner of the vineyard returns what will he do to those tenants
verses.literalPt: Quando, pois, vier o senhor da vinha, que fará àqueles lavradores?

verses.original: Λέγουσιν αὐτῷ Κακοὺς κακῶς ἀπολέσει αὐτούς καὶ τὸν ἀμπελῶνα ἐκδώσεται ἄλλοις γεωργοῖς οἵτινες ἀποδώσουσιν αὐτῷ τοὺς καρποὺς ἐν τοῖς καιροῖς αὐτῶν
verses.transliteration: Legousin autō Kakous kakōs apolesei autous kai ton ampelōna ekdōsetai allois geōrgois hoitines apodōsousin autō tous karpous en tois kairois autōn
verses.literal: He will bring those wretches to a wretched end they replied and will rent out the vineyard to other tenants who will give him his share of the fruit at harvest time . . .
verses.literalPt: Dizem-lhe eles: Dará afrontosa morte aos maus, e arrendará a vinha a outros lavradores, que a seu tempo lhe dêem os frutos.

verses.original: Λέγει αὐτοῖς ὁ Ἰησοῦς Οὐδέποτε ἀνέγνωτε ἐν ταῖς γραφαῖς Λίθον ὃν ἀπεδοκίμασαν οἱ οἰκοδομοῦντες Οὗτος ἐγενήθη εἰς κεφαλὴν γωνίας Παρὰ Κυρίου ἐγένετο αὕτη Καὶ ἔστιν θαυμαστὴ ἐν ὀφθαλμοῖς ἡμῶν
verses.transliteration: Legei autois ho Iēsous Oudepote anegnōte en tais graphais Lithon hon apedokimasan hoi oikodomountes Houtos egenēthē eis kephalēn gōnias Para Kyriou egeneto hautē Kai estin thaumastē en ophthalmois hēmōn
verses.literal: Jesus said to them Have you never read in the Scriptures The stone the builders rejected has become the cornerstone This is from the Lord and it is marvelous in our eyes
verses.literalPt: Diz-lhes Jesus: Nunca lestes nas Escrituras: A pedra, que os edificadores rejeitaram, Essa foi posta por cabeça do ângulo; Pelo Senhor foi feito isto, E é maravilhoso aos nossos olhos?

verses.original: Διὰ τοῦτο λέγω ὑμῖν ὅτι ἀρθήσεται ἀφ’ ὑμῶν ἡ βασιλεία τοῦ Θεοῦ καὶ δοθήσεται ἔθνει ποιοῦντι τοὺς καρποὺς αὐτῆς
verses.transliteration: Dia touto legō hymin hoti arthēsetai aph’ hymōn hē basileia tou Theou kai dothēsetai ethnei poiounti tous karpous autēs
verses.literal: Therefore . . . I tell you that the kingdom of God will be taken away from you and given to a people who will produce its fruit
verses.literalPt: Portanto, eu vos digo que o reino de Deus vos será tirado, e será dado a uma nação que dê os seus frutos.

verses.original: καὶ ὁ πεσὼν ἐπὶ τὸν λίθον τοῦτον συνθλασθήσεται ἐφ’ ὃν δ’ ἂν πέσῃ λικμήσει αὐτόν
verses.transliteration: kai ho pesōn epi ton lithon touton synthlasthēsetai eph’ hon d’ an pesē likmēsei auton
verses.literal: He who falls on this stone will be broken to pieces but he on whom it falls will be crushed . . .
verses.literalPt: E, quem cair sobre esta pedra, despedaçar-se-á; e aquele sobre quem ela cair ficará reduzido a pó.

verses.original: Καὶ ἀκούσαντες οἱ ἀρχιερεῖς καὶ οἱ Φαρισαῖοι τὰς παραβολὰς αὐτοῦ ἔγνωσαν ὅτι περὶ αὐτῶν λέγει
verses.transliteration: Kai akousantes hoi archiereis kai hoi Pharisaioi tas parabolas autou egnōsan hoti peri autōn legei
verses.literal: When the chief priests and Pharisees heard His parables they knew that Jesus was speaking about them
verses.literalPt: E os príncipes dos sacerdotes e os fariseus, ouvindo estas palavras, entenderam que falava deles;

verses.original: καὶ ζητοῦντες αὐτὸν κρατῆσαι ἐφοβήθησαν τοὺς ὄχλους ἐπεὶ εἰς προφήτην αὐτὸν εἶχον
verses.transliteration: kai zētountes auton kratēsai ephobēthēsan tous ochlous epei eis prophētēn auton eichon
verses.literal: Although they wanted to arrest Him they were afraid of the crowds because the people regarded Him as a prophet
verses.literalPt: E, pretendendo prendê-lo, recearam o povo, porquanto o tinham por profeta.
